buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a) Vendor Qualification Criteria: Firms successfully supplied Ammunition Racks for Navy war ships can only participate in tender. Firm shall attach documentary evidence for the same faili ng which offer will be ignored. b) Firm has to manufacture, supply and install Ammunition Racks Qty 06 sets at M/s HSL Viz ag and 04 sets at M/s L&T Kattupalli – Qty 2 sets per ship. Total Qty 10 sets for 5 ships. c) Firm shall manufacture Ammunition racks as per Specification, Scope of work and Drawin g attached. Total rocket storage capacity shall be 98 no’s (49 no’s + 49 no’s) for each ship. To tal storage capacity for 10 sets shall be 98 x 10 = 980 no’s. d) QAP to be prepared and to be forwarded to MTPF for further approval by concerned Navy Inspectorat e. e) Inspection will be done by CQAE(WS) inspectors at firm’s premises from Raw Material sta ge to Finish Stage as per approved QAP. Primers and Paints to be used for surface coating of Ammunition Racks shall be tested at NABL accredited lab only/NMRL or Govt Labs in presence of CQAE(WS) inspectors. All the stage inspection calls are to be given to MTPF in prescribed fo rmat and MTPF will arrange Navy Inspector’s visits at firm’s premises. f) Firm shall submit CQAE(WS) dispatch clearance report for the Qty inspected and Work Completion Cer tificate issued by the Ship authority for claiming stage wise payment. g) Total required quantity is 10 sets and Payment will be processed case to case basis on submission of above documents. h) Liasoning with ship authorities for obtaining permissions onboard will be the responsibility of firm. i) Transportation of Ammunition rack to MTPF shall be arranged by the firm. MTPF will arrange further tr ansportation to Navy Ships. j) Delivery period: 120 days (for delivery at MTPF) after receipt of supply order k) Option Clause: Not Applicable l) Earnest Money Deposit: 3% applicable m) Performance Security Deposit: 3% applicable against S.O. value, Validity of PSD should be 14 month s from the date of final delivery, PSD should be submitted within 01 month from the date of receipt of Sup ply Order. n) Payment Terms: 80% against delivery of Ammunition Racks at MTPF along with dispatch clearance by CQAE(WS). Balance 20% after installation of Ammunition racks onboard Navy ships along with work compl etion certificate issued by the Ship authority.

o) Guarantee/Warranty: Firm has to give Guarantee/Warranty Certificate. The item should be guarantee d for a period of 01 year. p) Techno commercial terms like specification, deviations, freight charges, insurance, taxes, duties & ot her expenses if any should be specifically indicated in the offer. q) In case there is any amendment by Govt. in Taxes/Levies/Duties, the same will be reviewed and ame ndment will be issued from time to time. r) Bidder must sign and stamp Specification, Scope of work and Buyer Added specific Terms & conditions page duly with acceptance remarks and upload the same along with the bid docu ment failing which the offer may be ignored. s) Amount of LD: The standard Liquidated Damages percentage is 0.5% per week (or part thereof) of the prices of any stores/services which the contractor has failed to deliver within delivery period specified in th e contract. t) Note - Firm has to submit following Documents along with Bid - 1) Local Content Declaration form for the subject store against this customized Bid 2) Non-Disclosure Agreement on Firm's Letter Head . 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): CQAE(WS)/NAVAL INSPECTOR AT FIRMS PREMISES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: MTPF REPRESENTATIVE AT AVNL MTPF AMBARNATH 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. NAME OF THE FIRM hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules.

6. Ration Item ATCs Demurrage charges In case the rejected items are not lifted by the firm within 48 hrs, the demurrage charges at the rate of 0.5% of total contract value will be charged per day. In case the items are not lifted within a month, the same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be admitted.Demurrage charges. In case the items are not lifted within a month, the same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be admitted. 7. Ration Item ATCs Packing Material The items will be supplied by the successful bidder in its original packing material and the packing material will not be returned. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity supplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size. Item will not be accepted in non-standardized weights.Packing Material. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity supplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size.
